source.metadata_gate: current URL/ETag/header/shape/codec/ON-OFF and actual range-byte proof; historical headers are preparation input only
source.axis_order: time,feed,frequency from physical shape+BL filterbank specification; inconsistent DIMENSION_LABELS retained in evidence

drift.frame: archive receiver-frequency, linear over actual cadence times
drift.construction: n=ceil(max_drift*Tspan/min(abs(df))); linspace(-max_drift,+max_drift,2*n+1); exact central grid zero
drift.trajectory_index: rint((f_reference+d*t_relative-fch1_hz)/df_hz)-decoded_source_channel0; ties to even; sum only complete tracks

detector.statistic: sum(winsorized-location-centered, row-MAD standardized residual in each odd box along nearest-channel track)/sqrt(Nrow*width)
detector.normalization_core: same fixed4096 native source channels per scan; divide power by core row median; subtract501-frequency-runningmedian; m0=median core residual; s=1.4826*median(abs(core residual-m0)); location=m0+mean(clip(core residual-m0,-5s,+5s)); z=(residual-location)/s
detector.maxima_ties: first width in1,3,9,33 then first ascending drift; strict greater update
detector.on_hit_definition: one maximum over complete fixed width/drift bank per declared reference carrier per ONscan; every maximum>=10 retained
detector.predeclared_valid_mask: all pixels valid; zero power allowed, nonfinite/negative/missing fails; no DC or amplitude-derived mask presumed
detector.edge_policy: full requested ONcarrier bank and OFFcompatibility bank must have decoded width/filter/track support; otherwise fail before search, never silently shrink bands

OFF_rule.rule: existential>=8 score among coupled compatible global linear hypotheses in any of3OFF scans; rawONhit retained with witness and disposition
OFF_rule.coupled_condition: at BOTH first and last integration midpoint of originating ONscan, abs((f0_OFF-f0_ON)+(d_OFF-d_ON)*t_ON)<=C*max(abs(df_ON),abs(df_OFF))
OFF_rule.frequency_family: intersect two endpoint f0 bounds for each triald andwidth; enumerate native OFF-reference centers in OFFhalo bank; score SAME resulting global hypothesis on complete OFFrows
OFF_rule.not_allowed: OFFwinner-only veto or combining independently maximized scores as a joint fit
OFF_rule.witness_traversal: width ascending; drift tiles ascending; carrier tiles increasing source-channel order; first score>=8 witness; stopped family marked nonexhausted, no complete count/max claim
OFF_rule.bank_halo_bound: ceil(Cmax+[2*Cmax*df/min_scan_span+2*gridstep]*max_abs_scan_midpoint/df), conservative only; actual compatibility uses coupled endpoint condition

controls.noise_regimes: 8each: Gamma16; Gaussian(mean1,sigma.05); rowgainGamma16(g=1+.1sin(2pi(row+.5)/16+scan*pi/3)); frequencyAR1Gaussian(rho.25,marginal sigma.05,mean1, stationary initialization). No clipping; anynonfinite/negativepower is generator failure

controls.injection_amplitude: peractivescan A=target*sigma/B; B=max_over_width[sum_of unit-profile within true nearest-channel odd box over allrows/sqrt(Nrow*width)], unfiltered noise-free unit oracle; sigma=.25 forGamma16; target24strong,12operating; nominalidealstatistic, not measured detectorSNR
controls.all_active_recovery: for EVERY injected ONscan at leastone correctlylocalized final SURVIVOR; report anyactive recovery separately
controls.localization: for each ONhit and truth active scan, C_recover=2+max(winning_width,truth_oracle_width)/2; pathdifference from truth <=C_recover*abs(df) at BOTH first andlast ONmidpoints; truth may calibrate injection and score evaluation only, never detectorinputs
